Write a new workbook with exactly one sheet 요약, range A1:C6, containing: a table 요약표 on A1:C4 with columns 지역 (text), 달성률 (number, format 0%), 전년 (number, format 0%); one data-bar rule on B2:B4 whose minimum is the number 0, whose maximum is 100 percent, and whose fill is #63BE7B. No other items.

Change the fill of the 달성률 data bar to #FFC7CE. Leave the 전년 bar green.
Change the 달성률 data bar so its minimum is 0 percent and its maximum is 100 percent (percent types, not num). Keep its fill and range.
